detail: web-d-map.e2e.ts seeds root > child-a, child-b > grand-a. On /map the heading is "Root" and [data-section=subcards] holds a[data-tile=child-a] and a[data-tile=child-b], with no grand-a tile; after a click on child-a (/map/child-a) the grand-a tile is in its sub-cards.

With /map open, `werk add append-log --title "Use an append-only log" --parent root` and `werk accept append-log --actor you` ran; the tile a[data-tile=append-log] with data-proposed=false appeared under root within 5 s, and the main frame had 0 navigations (no reload, no click).

A click on the child tile gave URL /map/child-a with the h1 title and [data-field=body]. #view has no contenteditable, no input/textarea in the title or body, and no textbox or button named edit/title/body (only the Note box and the copy/accept/remove buttons). After page.reload() the URL stays /map/child-a and the same h1 shows.

A second `bun src/cli.ts serve --port 0` in the same dir printed nothing for 5.25 s, then exited 1 with "werk: another werk is already serving this repository on port N (pid P)", which names the first pid; the first server still served the same cards. It never prints a line that it waits for the first server's pid (lock.ts polls silently), so the first Then fails. Missing feature, not a binder error.

The chat pane (aside aria-label=Chat) has no conversation tabs: getByRole('tab', {name:'design'}) found 0. The pane has a single thread, and POST /api/chat sends only {text} (no card, no tab). The composer sends only on Ctrl/Cmd+Enter or the Send button, so a plain Enter sends nothing. Missing feature.

A synthetic paste of a PNG File into the Message textbox, then typing the text and pressing Enter, gave 0 POST /api/chat requests (Enter alone does not send). The composer has no paste/image handling, and the request body holds only {text}, with no image, card or tab. Missing feature.

Messages sent with the Send button on /map/pr-log, then on /map/vi-prop-trace (opened through the refines link and a tile, no reload). The fake agent recorded the turn inputs "Explain the fold" and "And this one?": no input starts with #pr-log or #vi-prop-trace. Both replies showed in .msg.agent in order. Missing feature.

On /map/werk-cli the chat pane has no tab "alpha" or "beta" (getByRole('tab') found 0) and no control to create one. The server holds one chat agent for each project, so tabs cannot have separate agents. Missing feature.

An outside client read the page's werk-token meta and POSTed {id:'werk-chat', text:'check the stdin path'} to /api/notes: 200, exactly one new note.added naming werk-chat. The card's thread showed the note once, and the browser sent no /api/notes request. But the clipboard (pbpaste) did not hold `re #werk-chat "The composer sends a live agent turn": check the stdin path`; no code writes such a line. Missing feature.
